accounts.heroDesc: Manage the upstream account pool in one place: manual injection, file import, bulk checks and runtime status detection.
accounts.note: Every valid account can take part in chat, image and video generation; image quota, video quota and chat rate limits are tracked per capability and do not affect each other. The media quota field only shows data returned by the upstream and is 0 when there is no dedicated field.
accounts.manualHelp: Log in to chat.qwen.ai first, press F12 to open developer tools, find the token under Application / Storage → Local Storage, and paste the complete raw value into the box below.
accounts.manualWarn: Important: only paste the raw token value from Local Storage. Do not extract it from Network requests or the Authorization header.
accounts.manualWarn2: Do not include the Bearer prefix or paste the whole Authorization text. Email and password are optional; the system verifies the token before injecting it.

accounts.bulkHelp: Supports multi-line tokens, `email,token`, a JSON object, a JSON array, or webchat2api/CPA-style nested `accounts/items/data`.
accounts.bulkPlaceholder: One token per line, or paste JSON: [{"email":"a@qwen","token":"..."}]

settings.pasteKey: Paste ADMIN_KEY or an existing API key first
settings.fetchFailed: Failed to load settings, check the current session key
settings.keySaved: Key normalised and saved in this browser, refreshing data...
settings.keepaliveIntervalRange: The keepalive interval must be between 5 and 86400 seconds
settings.title: System settings
settings.desc: Manage console authentication, the model catalog, concurrency, the Chat_ID warm pool and usage examples.
settings.sessionKeyDesc: The browser does not read the backend data/api_keys.json automatically; paste ADMIN_KEY or an existing API key from that file here and the console will keep it in this browser.
settings.catalogDesc: Reads the currently available models from /v1/models and groups them by family, e.g. qwen3.6 models share one group.
settings.noModels: No model data. Make sure the session key may access /v1/models.
settings.concurrencyDesc: Runtime concurrency slots and queue thresholds (change them in the backend config.json and restart to apply).
settings.maxInflightDesc: Requests each upstream account handles at the same time. Too high risks a ban, too low under-uses the account.
settings.globalMaxDesc: Hard cap on in-flight requests across all accounts. 0 = unlimited. Matches the peak of async tasks on the Dashboard.
settings.poolDesc: Pre-create chat_ids to avoid the upstream /chats/new handshake (0.5~6s). Changes take effect immediately.
settings.poolTargetDesc: How many chat_ids to keep ready per account. Default 0 means no warm-up at startup.
settings.poolTtlDesc: A chat_id older than this is dropped and recreated so the upstream does not silently reclaim it. Default 10.
settings.keepaliveDesc: When set, the service periodically sends a GET request to this URL to stay online; leave empty to disable.
settings.keepaliveUrlLocked: KEEPALIVE_URL is injected from the environment; the panel does not override it.
settings.keepaliveIntervalLocked: KEEPALIVE_INTERVAL is injected from the environment; the panel does not override it.
settings.aliasesDesc: Model names sent by downstream clients are routed to the actual Qwen models below. Edit using standard JSON.

test.empty: Send a message to start testing; the system will call /v1/chat/completions.
